resources.string: Choose the modifier for Momentum commands. Text editing, Ctrl+A and Ctrl+, keep native Ctrl shortcuts.

Task commands use the visible selection and are unavailable in text fields or while a dialog or operation is active. Archive permits Undo only. Single-task commands require one selected task. Done reopens one completed task; with multiple tasks it marks them done. Move applies to selected main tasks. Nudge requires manual sorting. Alt mode uses Ctrl+Alt for nudging. Android or the keyboard may reserve some combinations.
